summary: The WebGPU backend’s wgpu library was bumped to several newer upstream revisions, bringing bug fixes, driver compatibility adjustments, and performance tweaks. Because WebGPU is the browser’s modern GPU API for rendering and compute, these wgpu updates help WebGPU-powered features run more reliably across different GPUs and drivers—**improving WebGPU reliability across GPUs and drivers**—with no expected visible user-interface changes.
